  Artificial Neural Network and Deep Learning [CSE-3271]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Differentiate between deep learning model learnable and hyperparameters using suitable  
  example.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      A 2-input and single-output neural network has weight values [1.3, 2.7] and bias of 1.6.  
  It is given an input [3.1, 2.4]. What is the output of identity function is used as activation  
  function? Also, what will be the output if the transfer function used is sigmoid activation (3)  
  function?  
  
  C)      List out the steps of learning methodology involved in Hebbian learning method in  
  detail.                                                                                      (5)  
  
  2)           Apply Multilayer feedforward network for credit scoring prediction task with the help of  
  an architecture diagram depicting various layers and mention input features, type of  
  (5)  
  layers, activation function, learning algorithm and loss function.  
  A)  
  B)      Implement a logistic regression based classifier by using Radial basis function network  
  architecture using python code.                                                              (5)  
  
  3)           Apply Kohonen Network architecture for any suitable data set and mention the steps of  
  learning process involved.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      List out the steps involved in training of real dataset and prediction of fake data set using  
  Generative Adversarial Networks with the help of block diagram.                               (5)  
  
  4)           Implement a Convolutional neural network based model using phyton code for  
  classifying any image data set by using any transfer learning model and print loss and  
  (5)  
  accuracy.  
  A)  
  B)      List out and brief features of any three different architectures of pretrained models.       (5)  
  5)           Differentiate between Convolutional neural network (CNN) and Recurrent neural                (5)  
  network (RNN) architectures using suitable example.
